name: Hero Cummy
source: Step into the world of superheroes and superpowers, as our protagonist trains to unlock the full potential of his lewd abilities! Help our hero fulfill his dream of creating his own super-powered harem by helping him survive U.A High. An adventure awaits filled with quirky heroes and villains, lewd costumes, and animated scenes! We hope you enjoy!​
